none: PAS KENT-4E0E64: Nummi/AE4 House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummi AE4 or Billon reduced Centenionalis of the House of Constantine commemorative issue. Obverse: Diadem (possible pearl) head right. Inscription: CONST[](IV)SNOB CA(ES). Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards. Inscription: GL(O)R[IA EXERCITVS]. Mint mark: Probably (TRS) Mint name: Probably Trier Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in very fine condition, only slightly worn with a slightly irregular flan and the reverse is struck a little off centre. The coin has a green surface patina with some pale green matt corrosion especially on the obverse. This coin is likely to date to 330-335AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011,…
